# Repository guidance

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for work-record selection, branch/PR delivery,
scope, validation, and repository boundaries. Small localized work can use a PR
without a separate issue; substantial or sensitive work requires an issue.

Read only the references needed for the task:

- [Testing Patterns](../docs/codebase/TESTING.md): local check selection and CI.
- [Coding Conventions](../docs/codebase/CONVENTIONS.md): established code patterns.
- [Architecture](../docs/codebase/ARCHITECTURE.md): component boundaries.
- [Developer skills](../docs/developer-skills.md): scoped workflows and maintenance.

Verify current dependencies, paths, and commands against manifests and source.
Use GitHub for current status; planning documents contain historical snapshots.
